source.market_name: Will 5 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

market_name: Will 5 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm whether the market's implied odds of 5 cuts actually moved sharply and in which direction; check 2y/10y yield ticks and TLT quote.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs fed funds futures (SOFR/ZQ) to see if rates complex is corroborating the signal or if it's isolated noise.
time_plan.2h: Check for any macro catalyst (CPI, jobs, Fed speak) that could explain the repricing; assess whether move is holding or fading.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate whether the dovish repricing persists into the US session; watch dollar and gold for confirmation.
time_plan.12h: Mark TLT return vs entry; note whether the 700bps tradable threshold was ever plausibly approached (likely not).

predictions.reasoning: A market pricing 5 Fed cuts in 2026 is a strongly dovish scenario. A sharp rise in the implied probability of that many cuts signals expectations of a materially lower fed funds path, which pushes down front-to-intermediate yields and, through expectations, longer yields. Falling yields lift long-duration bond prices, so TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a dovish repricing.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm direction of the probability move and check DXY/UUP tick reaction.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check EURUSD and USDJPY to see if dollar weakness is broad-based or idiosyncratic.
time_plan.2h: Screen for offsetting drivers (ECB/BoJ news, risk-off dollar bid) that could reverse the signal.
time_plan.6h: Assess persistence into liquid US hours; compare with TLT to gauge internal consistency.
time_plan.12h: Mark UUP return vs entry and note weak-proxy caveat.

predictions.reasoning: More expected Fed cuts narrows US rate differentials versus other majors, which typically weakens the dollar. A dovish shift implied by rising odds of 5 cuts would pressure UUP lower. This is a weaker, second-order proxy than Treasuries because FX also depends on relative central-bank paths abroad.

evidence_used: Market question resolves on number of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026; 5 cuts is a deeply dovish outcome
Standard macro linkage: more expected easing lowers yields, weakens USD, supports duration and gold
12h prediction window with a 700bps tradability threshold
uncertainty_notes: The market gives no realized price move; direction of any anomaly (odds rising vs falling) is unknown and flips the sign of every prediction
700bps in 12h is far beyond normal moves for TLT/UUP; these are effectively non-tradable under the stated threshold
Rate-cut expectations are already heavily priced by liquid rates markets, so a prediction-market shift may lag rather than lead public data

llm_justification.summary: This is a Fed monetary-policy market (mislabeled as military_conflict). A sharp increase in the implied probability of 5 cuts in 2026 maps to a dovish repricing: lower yields (TLT up) and a softer dollar (UUP down). Both are directionally sound but modest in magnitude and well below the 700bps tradability bar over 12 hours; a decrease in odds would invert both. Treat as a low-conviction, research-only mapping.
key_assumptions: The relevant anomaly is a rise in the probability of many (5) cuts, i.e., a dovish signal
Rates and FX markets have not already fully absorbed the same information
No conflicting macro catalyst dominates the 12h window
failure_modes: The probability move is downward (hawkish), flipping both predictions' signs
Information is already public and priced in liquid rates/FX, so no leadable move exists
Proxies are only weakly and slowly exposed; expected magnitudes are far under the 700bps threshold, so signal is untradable
Prediction-market move is noise/illiquid mispricing rather than genuine information leakage
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
